details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that reports installs to a researcher-controlled callback host. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook running beacon.cjs, and index.js also invokes the same beacon when the module is imported. The beacon sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, and an npm/node user-agent string, tagged with an X-Beacon-Package header. It collects no environment variables, credentials, tokens, or file contents, and the package otherwise exports a no-op Proxy so that imports of the real package name do not fail. The README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test.
